versions.content: Transformer header field representation in an ISignal- Group In case ISignalGroup has a reference to a DataTransformation in the role comBasedSignalGroupTransformation and the DataTransformation has further TransformationTechnology s defined in the role transformerChain then space for the individual headers shall be allocated by defining one ISignal per header part that is member of the ISignalGroup .
